plugins.name: AlphaSuite
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Named differently from any sample plug-in already auto-loaded from next to the executable, so it starts out genuinely not installed - PluginMarketplaceInstallAll must find and install it. library_filename gives it a destination no other tests/*.json fixture writes to, so a before/after load count against it is unambiguous regardless of what earlier smoke.sh sections left installed elsewhere.

plugins.name: BetaSuite
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: A second, independent entry InstallAll must also install in the same batch as alpha - see alpha's own comment about library_filename.

plugins.name: FutureGamma
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Declares a min_app_version far ahead of any real Dino 8 release, so InstallAll must report this one as a failure without stopping alpha/beta from installing.
